Hi all,

Quick update on Project Phoenix ahead of tomorrow's steering meeting.

Backend migration: the read path cutover to the new schema is complete and
has been stable in staging for five days. The write path cutover is behind
schedule — we hit an unexpected foreign-key issue in the billing tables that
cost us most of last week. Priya's team has a fix in review now and expects
to merge it by Wednesday.

Frontend: the new dashboard is feature-complete and in QA. Two accessibility
issues were flagged (missing focus outlines on the filter chips, and a
contrast ratio problem on the secondary buttons) — both are small fixes and
should not affect the timeline.

Overall we are now tracking about eight days behind the original schedule,
almost entirely due to the billing table issue above. If the write-path fix
lands Wednesday as expected, we can still hit the revised go-live date of the
19th, but there is no more slack left in the plan — any further slip pushes
us into next month.

Ask: I'd like sign-off tomorrow on the revised 19th date, and a decision on
whether we freeze scope now or allow the two accessibility fixes in as
planned (I'd recommend allowing them — they're small and already scoped).

Thanks,
Dana
